content.text:
- **`tool_choice`** controls whether and how the model can use the tools provided in the request. It takes the values:
  - `"none"` – the model will not call any tool
  - `"auto"` – the model decides whether to use tools
  - `"required"` – the model must use at least one tool
  [Tool use - Chat Completions API](https://docs.mistral.ai/api#operation/POST_chat_completions)

- **`parallel_tool_calls`** enables the model to invoke multiple tools simultaneously in a single turn.
  [Tool use - Chat Completions API](https://docs.mistral.ai/api#operation/POST_chat_completions)
